reader.notes: SortMapIoFiles refuses any USING or GIVING file whose AccessMode is Random, for both verbs and both phrases, with no edition switch, and 1985's rule is the same as §2023:12.4.5.5.2 SR1. Relative files run through SORT in both directions. The check lives on the statement, so a RANDOM file that no SORT/MERGE names is correctly left alone.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:XI.4.4.2: USING and GIVING both take a list of file names. Probe r6a at --std 85: the RANDOM relative file last in a SORT USING list, last in a SORT GIVING list, last in a MERGE USING list, and last in a MERGE GIVING list were each refused COBOL1757; the SEQUENTIAL, default and DYNAMIC relative files in the same lists drew no finding. r6b: a contained program SORTing a GLOBAL RANDOM relative file of its container was refused COBOL1757. cite.py: OK §1985:VIII.2.4.3 SR4 (2.4.3 Syntax Rules) the text is in SR4.
